headline: Steven Spielberg, Alec Baldwin and Gov. Kathy Hochul Turn Out for Dudamel
context: “I’m so happy here. Honestly,” Gustavo Dudamel, the superstar conductor, said at the New York Philharmonic’s season-opening gala on Wednesday.
